items.raw_excerpt: Two young tourists say they've never been more scared in their lives after 21-year-old Victorian woman Emma Hipwell was charged by a wild buffalo while holidaying in the Northern Territory.
items.summary_en: A 21-year-old woman from Victoria was charged by a wild buffalo while on holiday in the Northern Territory. She was tossed into the air and left bruised. She and her friends said it was the scariest moment of their lives.
items.summary_ko: 빅토리아주의 21세 여성이 북부 준주 여행 중 야생버펄로에게 공격받았다. 그녀는 공중으로 날려져 멍이 들었다. 그녀와 친구들은 인생에서 가장 무서운 순간이었다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Tourist tossed by wild buffalo in Australia
items.title_ko: 호주 북부에서 야생버펄로에 치인 관광객
items.title_original: Tourist left bruised after being charged twice by wild buffalo

items.raw_excerpt: Despite challenges facing the wine industry - declining alcohol consumption and a global glut of grapes - wine company Delegat Group has reported strong sales results for 2026 which it expects to continue.
items.summary_en: Delegat Group, a New Zealand wine company, reported strong sales for 2026. The company expects growth to continue despite declining alcohol consumption and a global glut of grapes.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 와인 회사인 Delegat Group이 2026년 매출 호조를 보고했습니다. 알코올 소비 감소와 전 세계 포도 공급 과잉에도 불구하고 회사는 성장이 지속될 것으로 전망합니다.
items.title_en: NZ wine company posts strong sales despite headwinds
items.title_ko: 뉴질랜드 와인 회사, 업계 역풍 속에서도 매출 호조
items.title_original: Increased sales see wine group pouring back into business

items.summary_en: The mayor of eThekwini is asking councillors to help fix billing issues. Residents are being taught how to file disputes over incorrect bills. This effort aims to improve city services for people in the area.

items.raw_excerpt: Mining company Sibanye-Stillwater hopes to have the Mt Lyell copper mine near Queenstown back up and running in 2029, creating 300 jobs in the process.
items.summary_en: Sibanye-Stillwater plans to reopen the Mount Lyell copper mine near Queenstown in 2029. The project is expected to create 300 jobs for the region.
items.summary_ko: 시반예-스틸워터가 퀸스타운 근처 마운트 라일 구리 광산을 2029년 재가동할 계획이다. 해당 프로젝트로 지역에 300개의 일자리가 생길 전망이다.

items.raw_excerpt: An investigation by the Data Protection Commission into the storage of paper records by the HSE has found incidents of documents contaminated by animal droppings, destroyed by mould, covered in rubble, or rotting due to water damage.
items.summary_en: Ireland's Data Protection Commission fined the Health Service Executive 645,000 euros. Investigators found paper records covered in animal droppings, mould, rubble, and water damage.

items.raw_excerpt: About 750 residents in rural Marlborough are being asked to conserve water after a major leak was discovered late on Tuesday night.
items.summary_en: About 750 people in rural Marlborough, New Zealand, must save water after a big leak was found on Tuesday night. The cause of the leak has not been found yet. Residents are being asked to use less water until repairs can be made.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 외곽 마르보로 지역 주민 약 750명이 화요일 밤 발견된 큰 누수 때문에 물 절약을 요청받았다. 누수 원인은 아직 밝혀지지 않았다. 주민들은 수리가 완료될 때까지 물 사용을 줄여야 한다.
items.title_en: 750 Rural NZ Residents Asked to Conserve Water After Leak
items.title_ko: 누수 원인 미확인, 뉴질랜드 농촌 주민 750명에 절수 촉구
items.title_original: Rural Marlborough residents told to conserve water, as cause of leak not yet found

items.summary_en: Seventeen-year-old Thea Frodin made her US Open debut on Tuesday. The young tennis player appeared as Serena Williams' double in the film King Richard five years ago. She still hopes to meet her idol Serena Williams in person.

items.raw_excerpt: El proyecto que busca extender las Fiestas Patrias 2026 fue aprobado, en general, en la Comisión de Gobierno Interior de la Cámara Baja.
items.summary_en: Chile's Congress is working on a bill to extend the 2026 Fiestas Patrias celebrations. The proposal was approved in general by the Interior Government Commission of the Lower House.

items.raw_excerpt: Crathorne is a small North Yorkshire village near Stokesley with a remarkable heritage claim.
items.summary_en: Crathorne is a small village in North Yorkshire with two Grade II* listed churches. The village has a remarkable heritage claim with its historic churches. This makes it a special place to visit in the English countryside.

items.summary_en: Coquimbo Unido will host their postponed Liga fixture against Universidad de Concepcion without fans in the stadium. The match was originally scheduled for late July but was rescheduled. Both teams see the game as crucial for their league ambitions.

items.raw_excerpt: A man who slipped near a wet floor sign at a Canberra McDonald's is awarded nearly $15,000 in compensation, after initially seeking millions.
items.summary_en: A man slipped near a wet floor sign at a McDonald's in Canberra, Australia. He initially sought more than $2 million in damages but was awarded nearly $15,000 in compensation.

items.summary_en: Children in Vijayapura, Karnataka rode bicycles while blindfolded to attempt a world record. Videos of the achievement have been submitted to an organisation that documents world records.

items.raw_excerpt: A student said: “We pay ₹2.45 lakh annually towards hostel fees. The drinking water is chlorinated, which causes sore throat. After paying hefty fees, they expect us to purchase drinking water from shops.”
items.summary_en: Students at Dayanand Sagar University in Bengaluru staged a protest over poor hostel conditions at the Harohalli campus. They said the drinking water smells of chlorine and gives them sore throats. Students argued they should not have to buy bottled water after paying high hostel fees.
items.summary_ko: 방갈로르 데이아난드 사가르 대학교 하로할리 캠퍼스 학생들이 기숙사 시설 문제로 항의 시위를 벌였다. 학생들은 수돗물에 섞인 염소 냄새 때문에 목이 아프다고 호소했다. 높은 기숙사비를 내고도 사 먹어야 하는 생수 문제를 지적하며 개선을 요구하고 있다.
items.title_en: Students protest poor hostel facilities at Bengaluru university
items.title_ko: 방갈로르 대학 기숙사 시설 불만 학생 시위
items.title_original: Students of Dayanand Sagar university protest against poor hostel facilities at Harohalli campus in Bengaluru

items.raw_excerpt: Run by second-generation owner Tommy Pang, the food court at ESR BizPark @ Chai Chee is just “10 to 20 per cent occupied” on weekdays. Unable to attract tenants, his family now runs seven of the eight stalls there.
items.summary_en: A food court in Singapore's Chai Chee area has lost S$250,000 in just seven months. Second-generation owner Tommy Pang says the place is only 10 to 20 per cent occupied on weekdays. His family now runs seven of the eight stalls themselves.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 차이치 지역의 한 푸드코트가 7개월 만에 25만 싱가포르달러의 적자를 기록했다. 2세 경영주 토미 팽 씨에 따르면 평일 점유율은 10~20%에 불과하며, 현재 8개 매장 중 7개를 본인이 직접 운영하고 있다.
items.title_en: Bai Nian Food Court at Chai Chee loses S$250,000 in 7 months
items.title_ko: 차이치 바이니안 푸드코트, 7개월 만에 25만 싱가포르달러 적자
items.title_original: Bai Nian Food Court at Chai Chee lost S$250,000 in 7 months: 'There are just no people anymore'

items.raw_excerpt: Atlético Mineiro clasificó a las semifinales de la Copa de Brasil, tras remontar por 2-1 ante Cruzeiro en el Clásico de Belo Horizonte y ganar 3-2 la llave global de cuartos. Kaio Jorge abrió la cuenta, pero Víctor Hugo y Fred lo dieron vuelta para el "Galo", que enfrentará en la próxima fase al vencedor del clásico de Porto Alegre entre Gremio e Inter.
items.summary_en: Atlético Mineiro came from behind to beat Cruzeiro 2-1 in Belo Horizonte. They won 3-2 on aggregate to reach the Copa Brasil semifinals. They will face the winner of the Grêmio vs. Internacional match.
items.summary_ko: 아틀레치쿠 미네이루가 벨루오리존치에서 크루제이루에 2-1 역전승을 거뒀다. 통합 스코어 3-2로 8강 시리즈를 승리하며 브라질 컵 4강에 진출했다. 다음 라운드에서는 그레미우와 인테르나시오날의 승자를 만난다.
items.title_en: Atlético Mineiro beats Cruzeiro to reach Copa Brasil semifinals

items.title_original: Atlético Mineiro remontó ante Cruzeiro en el clásico y clasificó a semifinales en la Copa de Brasil

items.raw_excerpt: Youths accounted for the largest share of SG Culture Pass credit usage, at 43 per cent.
items.summary_en: More than $30 million in SG Culture Pass credits have been used so far, with youths making up the largest share at 43 per cent. A new online portal has been introduced to help seniors discover and join cultural outings. The programme aims to bring more people in Singapore to enjoy live arts performances.
